item.title: Watch: Will Ukraine get the support needed as tensions with US rise?

item.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France

item.description: Violence broke out across France, with more than half a million people taking to the streets over the weekend.

item.title: Inside Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US

item.description: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.

item.description: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

item.description: Political tension grips France after rioting marred protests over the cost of living and struggling public services, Katya Adler writes.

item.title: Possible wreckage of Amelia Earhart's plane likely to be trees, say researchers

item.title: Kenya pastor accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death faces verdict
item.description: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie faces 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

item.title: Alberta heads to polls to decide whether to hold vote on separation from Canada
